author.name: Charlie Munger
author.heading: About Charlie Munger
author.bio: Charlie Munger trained as a lawyer and became Warren Buffett’s long-term investing partner at Berkshire Hathaway. He also chaired Wesco Financial and the Daily Journal Corporation. His public talks combine business examples with psychology, mathematics and lessons about practical judgment.

context.heading: The setting behind the words
lead: Munger’s answer compares material progress with dissatisfaction about relative wealth. He argues that people can take improved conditions for granted while focusing on others who have more. The transcript presents this as his explanation, not as an independently established social-science finding. Oliver Sung meeting transcript ↗
